I've been writing my own futurist series that goes all the way up to 3012, and I want to know how you came up with your ideas?<ac_metadata title="Hello!"> </ac_metadata>

It's more or less a prediction of the future, heavily  based in "The next 100 years", from George Friedman, but with a lot of work put on the details to make it more concrete and believeable. You can find more maps and info at Ynot1989 Deviantart's page.

Its taken me over a decade of work on this so that's a really hard question to ask.

At a high level, the timeline is heavily influenced by the works of George Friedman (a VERY imperfect writer, who happens to be one of the best forecasters out there), Jacob Shapiro and others of the greater STRATFOR, GPF community.

I pepper in climate change and space exploration in greater detail because those are two areas of my interest and expertese respectively. 

And there's lots of little stuff inspired from movies, anime, videogames, and of course actual history.

Very interesting. My series is very similar, I specialize in wars and space exploration, my series has taken a while, I've only gotten the next two centuries fleshed out, and there's still roughly 700 or 800 years to finish. 

I too study history, as it is the only way to know the future. 

My series, like yours, changes as the years go by. 

I am currently starting a wiki for it. 

Thank you for your quick reply.
